from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, capturing its title and citation links to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
